about: The platform's material (docs/adr/0069-the-platforms-material.mdx), the compositor's part: sample/MaterialMenuProbe.tsx, a window of four colour bands (red, green, blue, yellow, each 100 pixels wide below a white strip holding its buttons). Its menu (Bloom's DropdownMenu, a floating surface) opens in a compositor popup over the bands: the popup has nothing of its own beneath its material, so the host draws its tint alone and tells the compositor the menu's frame and corners (`material.regions`), and the compositor blurs and saturates the bands beneath it there. Under the menu the bands mix across their edges under its tint; outside it they are as sharp as they were. Its dialog (Bloom's Dialog, a floating surface drawn in the window over its content) is the host's part: the window's own bands beneath it blurred under its tint.

steps.name: the menu opens over the bands: they mix beneath it under its tint, and stay sharp outside it
the menu closed: the bands sharp again where it was
the dialog opens over the bands in the window, dimmed behind it: the host blurs them beneath it under its tint (the dimmed bands mix across their edges), and they stay sharp around it
